geopolitics_summary: US-Iran military escalation and midterm politics risk crude/oil supply disruption; EU seeking strategic autonomy in procurement and clean energy.

themes.headline: US military destroys Iranian oil tankers; Trump signals post-midterm Iran resolution
themes.why_it_matters: Direct crude supply risk. Iranian tanker losses tighten global crude, raising oil prices and fuel-switching incentives for EU power generation (coal/gas), supporting power and heating margins.

themes.headline: US LNG exports rose 23% H1 2026 on new capacity additions
themes.why_it_matters: Increased US LNG supply (17.4 Bcf/d) reduces global LNG scarcity, improving arbitrage terms into Europe. Lower TTF via LNG competition suppresses EU gas and power prices; weakens fuel-switch premium.

themes.headline: EU data centers should build own clean energy to avoid power bill spikes
themes.why_it_matters: Ribera's push for corporates to self-supply reduces EU baseload demand on grid. Lower peak demand eases DA spreads and power curve; CPV/wind contracts may cannibalize merchant prices.

themes.headline: August hottest month on record; EU blames fossil fuel burning
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained heat drives cooling demand and hydro pressure. Elevated temps fuel climate-policy urgency, supporting carbon price and renewable investment momentum; near-term power demand tail risk.

themes.headline: Ireland backs EU carbon-border-tax and e-waste levy; corporate/tobacco taxes blocked
themes.why_it_matters: Carbon border adjustment advancing signals cost floor for imports; supports EUA floor and EU power competitiveness vs. non-compliant regions. Delayed broader fiscal union reduces EU industrial capex support.

watchlist: EU budget revenue negotiation (Costa tour Berlin, Warsaw, Madrid) — fiscal clarity affects industrial power demand.
US midterm elections (November) — Trump Iran resolution risk; impacts crude/LNG export policy.
ERCOT peak load sustainability — US heat-driven demand may bid up global LNG prices, tightening EU gas margins.
Data-center power PPA negotiation timeline — corporate self-supply decisions shape EU grid demand profile.
